data.title: Real-Time Payment to New Payee After Credential or Contact Change
data.description: Detects when a real-time or instant payment (Zelle, FedNow, RTP) is initiated to a previously unseen payee within 24 hours of a credential change (password reset, MFA re-enrollment) or contact information update (email, phone, address). This pattern is strongly associated with account takeover followed by immediate monetization via authorized push payment.

enrichment_required.source: Change correlation enrichment (hours since last credential change)
Relationship analytics enrichment (payee relationship status lookup)

falsepositives: Customer who legitimately updated their phone number and then paid a new contractor
Periodic password rotation coinciding with routine bill payment to a new provider
